submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold provides the highest signal efficiency (92%) at the allocated 8 kHz L1 rate. This algorithm is deployable within L1 FPGA resource constraints and is an option listed in candidate_specs.md. Efficiency values are confirmed by simulations and consistent with the emulation summary. The threshold is within the required 20–60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 is listed as a candidate in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md states Algorithm-L1 fits the Level-1 FPGA resource budget.
The recommended threshold is 30 GeV, within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV threshold provides the maximal measured signal efficiency (92%) at the 8 kHz allocated rate, per simulation.
